Items.Title: Apple Account devices and Sign in with Apple apps are not audited by any connector
Items.Action: Review the devices and the apps using Sign in with Apple, and remove the ones you no longer use (docs/manual-review.md). Mark this done when checked.

Items.Title: Google recovery options and passkeys are not audited by any connector
Items.Action: On every Google account, run Security Checkup (sessions, devices, recovery phone and email) and register a passkey or security key; remove SMS as a second factor (docs/plan.md, section 1). Mark this done when checked.

Items.Title: The password manager's reused and breached password report is not audited by any connector
Items.Action: Review 1Password Watchtower or Bitwarden Reports and change the reused, weak and breached passwords (docs/plan.md, section 2). Mark this done when checked.

Items.Title: Stripe API keys are not audited by any connector
Items.Action: In every Stripe account, replace secret keys with restricted keys and delete the unused ones (docs/plan.md, section 6). Mark this done when checked.

Items.Title: Google Workspace administration is not audited: no workspace tenant could be read
Items.Action: Set up read-only Admin SDK credentials for each tenant (README.md, "Google Workspace administration"), then run the connector.

Items.Title: 2 database dumps in the git history of ~/src/api (2.5 MB)
Items.Action:
Treat the data as exposed to everyone who could clone the repository. Rotate every credential the dumps hold, then purge them from history in one pass: `git filter-repo --invert-paths --path 'db/prod.sql' --path 'backup.dump'` and force-push every branch and tag; collaborators must re-clone. segurata never rewrites history or pushes.
Files: db/prod.sql (x, pushed); backup.dump (x, pushed).
If they hold personal data of customers or staff, check the GDPR breach notification duty (72 hours): https://www.aepd.es/es/derechos-y-deberes/cumple-tus-deberes/medidas-de-cumplimiento/brechas-de-datos-personales, https://www.edpb.europa.eu/documents/guideline/guidelines-92022-on-personal-data-breach-notification-under-gdpr_en.
Findings: local-secrets repo= project= Database dump committed to ~/src/api: backup.dump
local-secrets repo= project= Database dump committed to ~/src/api: db/prod.sql
